name: MedFlowBench
description: Medical imaging benchmarks often evaluate VLMs on pre-selected 2D images, slices, crops, or patches, making evaluation closer to visual recognition. Real clinical workflows impose a different burden: readers must search through complete studies, operate imaging software, navigate across slices and magnifications, and document visual evidence that can be audited. We argue that this evidence-producing workflow is a critical missing evaluation axis for medical imaging agents.
